name: Fireguard
tagline: Harmonized MODIS-VIIRS hotspot calendar and next-day outlook for Chile and Argentina
challenge: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots

base_case.name: Harmonized burn calendar
base_case.method: MODIS times a factor per region, calendar month and pass (2012-2021), shrunk towards the country factor; one satellite per period

added_value_1.name: Next-day outlook
added_value_1.algorithm: One LightGBM per country; TreeSHAP reasons; Open-Meteo wind for the live day (context, not a feature)

added_value_2.name: Area at risk and zones around active fires
added_value_2.algorithm: Hotspots linked within 1 km on a sphere; chance of being detected again (within 2 km) and 50/80/90% radii per size class, fitted on 2013-2022
